title: Storm Charged Battery
definition: The concept of a human body being charged by a storm system, acting as a capacitor in an electrical circuit.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of a storm like a wireless charger for your body. It creates an electric field that makes you a temporary battery, charging you up and giving you energy.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: During a storm, the massive charge separation between the cloud base and the ground creates a strong electric field. Your body, full of electrolytes, acts like a capacitor, absorbing ions and charged aerosols from the storm. This results in a literal transfer of electrical potential from the storm to your body.
difficulty_levels.expert: The storm's ion factory pumps charged particles into the atmosphere, which then migrate onto and into the human body. This results in a significant modification of the body's membrane potentials, altering the electrical properties of every cell. This concept challenges traditional views of human-environment interactions, highlighting the intricate and interconnected nature of biological and physical systems.

extra_fields.insight: The storm's ion factory pumps charged particles into the atmosphere, which then migrate onto and into the human body, modifying the body's membrane potentials.
